prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic vertical themed-cafe portrait in a Jirai Kei-inspired editorial style, preserving the red ribbon, hime cut, spoon gesture and Japanese set meal.
prompt.main_subject: One original approved adult woman with pale natural skin, jet-black precise hime-cut hair, a long crimson ribbon bow, red-tinted eye makeup, soft pout and realistic facial texture. She wears a grey-and-black plaid structured camisole, a loose white fuzzy cardigan worn off the shoulders and a silver chain with a dark red heart pendant.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical 9:16 eye-level close-to-medium portrait with food stacked in the lower third and the adult subject centered above it. She holds a black ceramic spoon near her cheek and looks directly at camera. Include tonkatsu, shredded cabbage, rice, soup, a character-themed food pick and themed-cafe posters/booth in the background.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright high-key diffuse indoor lighting from overhead and front, with soft shadows and clear texture on face, knit, plaid and food. Keep the mood playful, stylized and editorial without sexualized framing.
prompt.technical_specs: 9:16 vertical, Sony A7R V with 35mm f/1.4 lens feel at f/2.8, sharp face and spoon, realistic food detail, moderate background falloff, natural skin texture and high-resolution cosplay photography.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photorealistic vertical themed-cafe portrait in a Jirai Kei-inspired editorial style of one original approved adult woman with pale natural skin, jet-black precise hime-cut hair, a long crimson ribbon bow, red-tinted eye makeup, a soft pout and realistic facial texture. She wears a grey-and-black plaid structured camisole, a loose white fuzzy cardigan worn off the shoulders and a silver chain with a dark red heart pendant. Use a 9:16 eye-level close-to-medium portrait with food stacked in the lower third and the subject centered above it; she holds a black ceramic spoon near her cheek and looks directly at camera. Include tonkatsu, shredded cabbage, rice, soup, a character-themed food pick and themed-cafe posters and booth. Use bright high-key diffuse indoor light, realistic face, knit, plaid and food detail, moderate background falloff and a 35mm f/2.8 editorial look.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized pose, child, teen, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed hands, distorted anatomy, missing spoon, wrong food, duplicated food, invented logos, unreadable added text
